request: Maintainer, 23 November 2026: big GitHub Actions cleanup, keep the latest 500 runs. Pass 2: pass 1 (run 45188139428, plan actions-cleanup-2026-11-23.json) deleted 1008 runs, then stopped on an HTTP 500 from GitHub.
policy_notes: Keeps the newest 500 runs of this snapshot and of every listing during execution, and every run created after the snapshot.

Keeps every older run whose run or artifact ID is cited by an executable file of Claude or main (workflows, diagnostics, pins, recipes, tests, sources), by the current delivery manifest build-utils/delivery/826.json or by an evidence file a live route reads.
Keeps main/Backup runs, non-terminal runs (including the nine refused queued orphans) and the latest success of every workflow that executed since 13 November.
Claude may advance during execution: every blob changed after the executing commit is read and a target it cites (run or artifact ID) is kept.
Deleting a target run deletes its artifacts. No branch, workflow definition, release or other artifact is changed.
